mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO payment_order (pay_no, biz_order_id, user_id, amount, subject, state, pay_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{payNo}, #{bizOrderId}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{subject}, #{state}, #{payTime}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, pay_no, biz_order_id, user_id, amount, subject, state, pay_time, create_time, update_time FROM payment_order WHERE pay_no = #{payNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_order SET state = 'PAID', pay_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE pay_no = #{payNo} AND state = 'WAIT_PAY'
UPDATE payment_order SET state = 'CLOSED', update_time = NOW() WHERE biz_order_id = #{bizOrderId} AND state = 'WAIT_PAY'
